name: beauty-queen
description: Beauty Queen E-commerce - Next.js + NestJS Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate
scripts.db:pull: cd apps/api && npx prisma db pull
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && npm run lint && cd ../web && npm run lint
